scripts.test: vp test --coverage --project node && vp test --project db --project core --project mcp --project api && node tools/ingest/scripts/smoke-text.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply CORPUS --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c packages/db/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply APP --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c packages/db/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply APP --remote -c packages/db/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:app-staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply APP --remote --env staging -c packages/db/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply CORPUS --remote -c packages/db/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply APP --remote --env staging -c packages/db/wrangler.jsonc
